scope: local pre-execution SOE accuracy/scaling design, not a release gate
basis: legacy retained; scaled_tail fits positive L1/GL-prefix tails with exact lag zero

accuracy.metrics: per-signal absolute/relative L2 errors against full discrete convolution; analytic quadratic error; fitted-kernel error

scaling.timing: serial shuffled rounds; dynamic inputs/order; fit plus application; whole-output synchronization; host checks excluded
scaling.memory: XLA compiler buffer accounting, not peak RSS/device memory

interpretation: Do not select configurations by favorable error or speed. Fixed poles/iterations need not preserve full-history convergence order; fit residuals are not universal relative derivative-error bounds. Report all rows and limitations.
